verdict.rationale: Signifyd's API lets merchants record Chargeback and Representment Outcome events, which feed confirmed fraud outcomes into the system, but the evidence pack never states that analyst review-queue decisions or these outcomes are used to retrain the model or update rules. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a review-queue/analyst decision feedback loop, evidence of model retraining or rule updates from confirmed outcomes, and any hands-on/independent confirmation that this loop improves detection.
